scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 4-UNIT NAZARIYA DAVOMI + MAShQLAR (21-bet, PDF 20). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '4'.

Och pushti ramka:
'Form': • We form the past continuous with was/were (past simple of the verb to be) and the main verb with the -ing. 'I was working. They were working.' We form questions by putting was/were before the subject. We form negations by putting the word not after was/were. 'Was he working? They were not/weren't working.'
'Use': We use the past continuous: • for an action which was in progress at a stated time in the past. We do not know when the action started or finished. 'At five o'clock yesterday I was cooking dinner.' • for a past action which was in progress when another action interrupted it. We use the past continuous for the action in progress (longer action) and the past simple for the action which interrupted it (shorter action). 'She was having breakfast when the phone rang.' • for two or more actions which were happening at the same time in the past (simultaneous actions). 'Tina was doing the washing-up while the children were playing in the garden.' • to give background information in a story. 'The sun was shining brightly as Tom was driving his brand new car through the city centre.'
'Time expressions we use with the past continuous': while, when, as, etc. Note: when/while/as + past continuous (longer action); when + past simple (shorter action)

PASTDA - 'Adjectives - Adverbs':
1) 'Turn the adjectives in brackets into adverbs to complete the dialogues.' 1 A: Why are you talking so ...... (loud)? B: I'm talking to my friend in Australia. She can't hear me. 2 A: I hear you passed your exams. B: Yes. I worked very ...... (hard) all year. 3 A: What's the weather like outside? B: It's snowing ...... (heavy) today. 4 A: Make sure you drive ...... (careful) today. B: Don't worry I'm always careful when the weather is bad. 5 A: What's that terrible noise? B: The trees are shaking ...... (violent) in the wind. 6 A: Why don't you get up ...... (early)? B: Because I go to bed very late at night. 7 A: What's this nice smell? B: It's ...... (fresh) ground coffee.
2) 'Underline the correct item.' 1 Today is a perfect/perfectly day to go on a picnic. 2 The little boy smiled sweet/sweetly at his mother. 3 Marie always dresses smart/smartly for work. 4 Michael got into his car and drove quick/quickly down the street. 5 She was carrying a beautiful/beautifully bouquet of flowers on her wedding day. 6 Final/Finally, he brushed his teeth and went to bed. 7 Vanessa was wearing a pretty/prettily dress at Tom's party. 8 Sam is a generous/generously man who often gives money to charities. 9 Lisa had a terrible/terribly dream last night. She woke up screaming. 10 Thanks so much for inviting us to the party. We had a great/greatly time. 11 They were talking quiet/quietly so I couldn't hear what they were saying. 12 This is a very busy street so you should always cross it careful/carefully. 13 Yoko is fluent/fluently in English. 14 Harry is a very polite/politely young man with good manners. 15 Was your history test easy/easily?

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '21'.

exercises.instructionEn: Form: We form the past continuous with was/were and the main verb with -ing: I was working. They were working. Questions: was/were before the subject; negations: not after was/were: Was he working? They weren't working. Use: for an action in progress at a stated time in the past (we do not know when it started or finished): At five o'clock yesterday I was cooking dinner. For a past action in progress when another action interrupted it - past continuous for the longer action, past simple for the shorter action: She was having breakfast when the phone rang. For two or more simultaneous actions in the past: Tina was doing the washing-up while the children were playing in the garden. To give background information in a story: The sun was shining brightly as Tom was driving his brand new car through the city centre. Time expressions: while, when, as. Note: when/while/as + past continuous (longer action); when + past simple (shorter action).
exercises.instructionUz: Shakl: was/were + asosiy fe'l-ing: I was working. They were working. Savol: was/were egadan oldin; inkor: was/were dan keyin not: Was he working? They weren't working. Ishlatilishi: o'tmishda MA'LUM PAYTDA davom etayotgan harakat (qachon boshlangani/tugagani noma'lum): Kecha soat beshda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim. O'tmishda davom etayotgan harakatni BOShQA HARAKAT UZGANDA - uzun harakat past continuous, qisqa harakat past simple: U nonushta qilayotganda telefon jiringladi. O'tmishda BIR VAQTDA bo'lgan ikki+ harakat: Tina idish yuvayotganda bolalar bog'da o'ynayotgan edi. Hikoyada FON ma'lumoti berish uchun: Tom yap-yangi mashinasini shahar markazidan haydab o'tayotganda quyosh charaqlab turardi. Vaqt so'zlari: while, when, as. Eslatma: when/while/as + past continuous (uzun harakat); when + past simple (qisqa harakat).
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST CONTINUOUS QAChON - 4 HOLAT.

  1) O'TMIShDA MA'LUM PAYTDA davom
     etayotgan harakat:
     At five o'clock yesterday I
     WAS COOKING dinner.
     (boshi-oxiri noma'lum)

  2) UZUN HARAKAT + QISQA UZILISh:
     She WAS HAVING breakfast
     (uzun - Continuous)
     when the phone RANG
     (qisqa - Simple)

  3) BIR VAQTDA IKKI HARAKAT:
     Tina WAS DOING the washing-up
     WHILE the children WERE
     PLAYING in the garden.

  4) HIKOYADA FON:
     The sun WAS SHINING brightly
     AS Tom WAS DRIVING his brand
     new car ...


BOG'LOVChILAR:

  while / as + Past Continuous
    (uzun)
  when + Past Simple (qisqa)

  ⚠ 'when' + Continuous ham
  mumkin: 'When I was cooking,
  ...'


⚠ 'BRAND NEW':

  = yap-yangi.

exercises.instructionEn: Turn the adjectives in brackets into adverbs to complete the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi sifatlarni ravishga aylantirib dialoglarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFAT → RAVISh.

  1 loud → LOUDLY
  2 hard → HARD (bir xil!)
  3 heavy → HEAVILY (-y → -ily)
  4 careful → CAREFULLY (ll)
  5 violent → VIOLENTLY
  6 early → EARLY (bir xil!)
  7 fresh → FRESHLY


⚠ 'FRESHLY GROUND COFFEE':

  = yangi tortilgan qahva
  (ground = tortilgan).


⚠ 'TO SHAKE':

  = silkinmoq.

items.textEn: A: Why are you talking so ___ (loud)? B: I'm talking to my friend in Australia. She can't hear me.
A: I hear you passed your exams. B: Yes. I worked very ___ (hard) all year.
A: What's the weather like outside? B: It's snowing ___ (heavy) today.
A: Make sure you drive ___ (careful) today. B: Don't worry I'm always careful when the weather is bad.
A: What's that terrible noise? B: The trees are shaking ___ (violent) in the wind.
A: Why don't you get up ___ (early)? B: Because I go to bed very late at night.
A: What's this nice smell? B: It's ___ (fresh) ground coffee.

exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATMI, RAVIShMI?

  OTDAN OLDIN / to be, look, feel
  dan keyin → SIFAT
  FE'LDAN KEYIN (qanday?) → RAVISh

  1 a PERFECT day (ot)
  2 smiled SWEETLY (fe'l)
  3 dresses SMARTLY (fe'l)
  4 drove QUICKLY (fe'l)
  5 a BEAUTIFUL bouquet (ot)
  6 FINALLY, he ... (ravish - gap
    boshida)
  7 a PRETTY dress (ot)
  8 a GENEROUS man (ot)
  9 a TERRIBLE dream (ot)
  10 a GREAT time (ot)
  11 talking QUIETLY (fe'l)
  12 cross it CAREFULLY (fe'l)
  13 is FLUENT (to be)
  14 a POLITE young man (ot)
  15 Was ... EASY? (to be)


⚠ 'TO DRESS SMARTLY':

  = chiroyli kiyinmoq.


⚠ 'FLUENT IN ENGLISH':

  = inglizchada ravon.

items.textEn: Today is a perfect/perfectly day to go on a picnic.
items.uz: Bugun piknikka borish uchun ajoyib kun.

items.textEn: The little boy smiled sweet/sweetly at his mother.
Marie always dresses smart/smartly for work.
items.uz: Meri ishga har doim chiroyli kiyinadi.

items.textEn: Michael got into his car and drove quick/quickly down the street.
items.uz: Maykl mashinasiga o'tirdi va ko'cha bo'ylab tez haydadi.

items.textEn: She was carrying a beautiful/beautifully bouquet of flowers on her wedding day.
items.uz: To'y kuni u chiroyli guldasta ko'tarib yurgan edi.

items.textEn: Final/Finally, he brushed his teeth and went to bed.
items.uz: Nihoyat, u tishini yuvdi va uxlagani yotdi.

items.textEn: Vanessa was wearing a pretty/prettily dress at Tom's party.
items.uz: Vanessa Tomning ziyofatida chiroyli ko'ylak kiygan edi.

items.textEn: Sam is a generous/generously man who often gives money to charities.
items.uz: Sem xayriyaga tez-tez pul beradigan saxiy odam.

items.textEn: Lisa had a terrible/terribly dream last night. She woke up screaming.
items.uz: Liza kecha dahshatli tush ko'rdi. U qichqirib uyg'ondi.

items.textEn: Thanks so much for inviting us to the party. We had a great/greatly time.
items.uz: Ziyofatga taklif qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Vaqtni ajoyib o'tkazdik.

items.textEn: They were talking quiet/quietly so I couldn't hear what they were saying.
items.uz: Ular sekin gaplashayotgan edi, shuning uchun nima deyishganini eshitolmadim.

items.textEn: This is a very busy street so you should always cross it careful/carefully.
items.uz: Bu juda gavjum ko'cha, shuning uchun uni har doim ehtiyotkorlik bilan kesib o'ting.

items.textEn: Yoko is fluent/fluently in English.
Harry is a very polite/politely young man with good manners.
Was your history test easy/easily?

patterns.formula: KIM + was/were + V-ing + when + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: She was having breakfast when the phone rang.

patterns.formula: KIM + was/were + V-ing + while + KIM + was/were + V-ing
patterns.exampleEn: Tina was doing the washing-up while the children were playing in the garden.
patterns.exampleUz: Tina idish yuvayotganda bolalar bog'da o'ynayotgan edi.

patterns.formula: At + VAQT + yesterday, KIM + was + V-ing
patterns.exampleEn: At five o'clock yesterday I was cooking dinner.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha soat beshda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim.

patterns.formula: KIM + FE'L + RAVISh / a + SIFAT + OT
patterns.exampleEn: The little boy smiled sweetly. Today is a perfect day.
patterns.exampleUz: Kichkina bola shirin jilmaydi. Bugun ajoyib kun.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Ravish fe'ldan keyin, sifat otdan oldin.
